description: LAFU Search synonyms: words that mean the same (kännykkä, puhelin, matkapuhelin). action list (default), set (words; optional id to replace a group, optional root for one-way: searching root also finds words), delete (id). Changes need confirm.

action.description: list is default; set and delete need confirm.

id.description: Group id: set replaces it, delete removes it.

root.description: One-way: searching this word also finds words.

site.description: LAFU Search site: OMA id or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

words.description: Words that mean the same, e.g. kännykkä, puhelin.
